title: Live transcript rendering — Rich-based CLI render of Pro/Con messages per round with inline controller nudges and the final verdict, consuming DebateEngine.stream (Epic 9, issue #65)
prompt:
Use Rich to render the live transcript: Pro and Con messages per round with inline controller nudges, and the final verdict.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: Switched the CLI `run` command from a blocking DebateEngine.run() + plain render_result to a Rich LIVE render driven by DebateEngine.stream(topic). TDD red-first: wrote packages/cli/tests/test_cli_live.py (stub _StreamingEngine yielding a CANNED sequence [Pro message, Con message, nudge, verdict, final DebateResult] via typer.testing.CliRunner — NO network/key), watched it fail (no _live module), then implemented to green. NEW renderer split across three files (each <150 code lines): cli/_live.py — render_stream(topic, events, console=None): prints a styled topic header then iterates the stream, rendering EACH LogEvent the instant it arrives (streaming, not buffered) and capturing the final DebateResult (returned, not rendered as an event). cli/_live_events.py — a dispatch table on event_type -> per-kind handlers: message -> side-coloured rich Panel titled 'Pro (round N)'/'Con (round N)'; nudge -> a DISTINCT dim/italic inline 'moderator nudge -> <target>: <correction>' marker (private moderator aside, shown where it occurs); verdict -> a final 'Verdict' Panel (winner/summary/rationale, summary+rationale optional). Unsurfaced kinds (tool_call/timeout/retry/system) are silently ignored for the human view. cli/_live_style.py — every label/colour/Rich style is a NAMED constant (no hard-coded values, guideline 7.2): Pro=bold green, Con=bold red, nudge=dim italic yellow, verdict=bold blue; side_label/side_style/format_topic pure formatters. Terminal Rich output, so the global RTL/CSS rules don't apply (noted in docstrings). Wired into app.py run(): render_stream(topic, engine.stream(topic)) as the DEFAULT human view; --json (9.3) deliberately not built but not precluded. The SDK still routes every model call through the Epic-13 gatekeeper (the CLI adds no external calls); cli_run_start still logged via the LOG package. Kept existing CLI tests green: updated test_cli_run.py's _RecordingEngine to provide .stream() (yields a Pro message + verdict + final DebateResult) instead of .run(); test_cli_render.py + _render.py untouched (still a valid non-live helper with its own tests). pyproject: added explicit rich>=13 to packages/cli deps (the renderer imports rich directly rather than relying on typer's transitive dep) and relocked (uv lock). Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 172 files already formatted; mypy = no issues in 172 source files; pytest --cov = 633 passed, 99.74% total (cli/_live.py + _live_events.py + _live_style.py + app.py at 100%; >=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0; secret_scan.py rc=0. Files: NEW cli/_live.py, cli/_live_events.py, cli/_live_style.py, tests/test_cli_live.py; EDIT cli/app.py (consume stream + render live), cli/pyproject.toml (rich dep), tests/test_cli_run.py (stub now streams), uv.lock, docs/PROMPTS.md (9.2 entry).
